summary: StorageFacade — the primary user-facing class. Protocol-checked dispatch to registered storage backends. Provides read(), read_stream(), write(), write_stream(), list_files(), list_directories(), delete(), exists(), metadata(), get_size(), copy(), mkdir(), rmdir(). Supports pipeline= and infer= keyword arguments on read paths. Class methods: from_path(path) infers provider from URL scheme; for_local() returns a local-filesystem facade. Internal _PairedStream ensures stream pair closure on read_stream().
lifecycle_notes: _require() raises UnsupportedOperationError if backend lacks a protocol — users see this when calling an unsupported operation
_PairedStream closes both pipeline wrapper and backend stream on close() to avoid file descriptor leaks
documentation_hooks: from_path() is the path-driven entry point — document that provider is inferred from URL scheme
The infer= flag on read/read_stream enables suffix-based transform inference
supports() lets users detect capabilities before calling an operation
risks: Missing _PairedStream.close() propagation would silently leak file descriptors on streaming reads
